source.name: Community Berger 30 Caliber 180 Grain Elite Hunter

loads.notes: Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Maroli; Posted: Oct 10, 2021; ES 45, SD 16.9, group .765 in. Peterson once-fired long brass. Federal GMM 215 LMR. COAL 3.600 and CBTO 2.800. Jump .045 off the lands. Factory 24 in barrel. 65 F, 68 percent humidity, 29.81 baro, no wind. Five-shot groups. No pressure signs and no sticky bolt. He did not shoot the 73.0 and 73.5 gr steps. Alliant's 185 gr Juggernaut charge was not copied. A partner's 208 gr Berger load in the thread is a different bullet.
